# Supply tight, prices climbing fast across logic and memory  
**Bottom line:** Market is in a high‑risk zone (supply 66.9, price 86.8) – push for price locks where advised and flag long‑lead parts for early purchase.

## What changed
- Overall supply risk unchanged at 66.9, price trend unchanged at 86.8; both remain in “Rising” / “Rising fast” zones[1].  
- Fab utilization slipped to 74.4% (below 10‑yr avg 80.0%), a modest loosening pressure on supply[3].  
- TSMC revenue up 56% YoY through Oct 2026, indicating tighter capacity demand[4].  
- Korea chip‑led exports doubled YoY in early Nov 2026, adding upward pressure on global supply[5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, stock 27,071 units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price $5.56 / 1 pc, $2.51 / 1k pcs.  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- **Buy‑timing call:** “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)” – 70 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate (14‑week lead, 17.6 weeks channel stock)[6].

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – supply 66.3 (Rising, ↔), price 83.8 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – supply 65.5 (Rising, ↔), price 74.3 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Analog & power management – supply 64.1 (Rising, ↓0.3), price 83.2 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – supply 64.7 (Rising, ↔), price 81.4 (Rising), confidence High.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – supply 62.4 (Rising, ↔), price 79.9 (Rising), confidence High.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – supply risk 77.3, lead time 52 weeks vs 12‑week norm.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – supply risk 77.3, 52‑week lead.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – supply risk 77.3, 52‑week lead.  
- **STM32G431CBT6** – supply risk 76.0, 52‑week lead.  
- **LM358DR** – supply risk 75.8, 26‑week lead (still double norm).

## Outlook
- Chip prices 3 mo: 77 % chance of rise, expected +7.05 % (80 % range –4.66 % to +18.76 %); model‑based edge confirmed[7].  
- Chip prices 6 mo: 76 % chance of rise, expected +14.1 % (range –1.13 % to +29.33 %); trend‑following baseline[8].  
- Fab utilization 3 mo: 52 % chance of tightening, expected +0.12 pts (range –3.17 pts to +3.41 pts)[9].  
- Fab utilization 6 mo: 51 % chance of tightening, expected +0.23 pts (range –5.23 pts to +5.7 pts)[10].  
- Buy‑timing: lock pricing on the 20 listed high‑risk parts (including the three 52‑week leads) and buy ahead on the rest per the “Buy ahead / lock pricing” list[11].

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock price now** on the 20 high‑risk parts (e.g., 10M08SAE144C8G, LCMXO2‑1200HC‑4TG100C) – suppliers will accept volume commitments to hedge against the 70‑+ % price‑rise probability.  
2. **Ask for expedited tooling or priority allocation** on the 52‑week lead parts; cite the 14‑week lead for the featured MOSFET as a benchmark for acceptable supply.  
3. **Leverage the modest fab utilization dip** (74.4 % vs 80 % avg) to negotiate better terms on lower‑risk segments (e.g., analog, power discretes) where supply pressure is easing.
